about: Seed memories are written word for word as pinned memories, with the Agent ID 'seed' and the tag 'seed'. 'space' is team-shared or leadership-shared.

memories.text: Our default branch is main, and every pull request needs one approving review before it is merged.
On-call handoff happens every Monday at 10:00, and the notes go in the #oncall-handoff channel.
Feature flags for checkout changes are named checkout_<feature> and live in the config service.
The leadership sync happens every Wednesday, and its notes are kept in the leadership folder.
The annual planning offsite is scheduled for the second week of November.
